en: Lillie
{player}! Over here. ...I wanted to say thank you. For what you did at the Foundation.
Nebby is a little better. It wants to go home, I think. It keeps saying so, in its own way.
Prof. Kukui
Welcome to Poni, cousin. The last island. There's a trial in Vast Poni Canyon, and a grand trial across the strait.
Captain Dulse is waiting up in Poni Wilds. His totem is a Kommo-o, and Kommo-o does not do small talk.
Lillie
I'm going to the Altar of the Sunne and Moone, on the other side of the island. I think that's where Nebby has to be.
Please be careful, {player}. And I'll see you there.
A Machamp on the shore nodded at {player}, as if to say it was ready to lend a hand.
Machamp
The Machamp flexed all four arms and pushed a boulder along the shore without a sound.
{player} registered Machamp in the Ride Pager! Machamp can shove boulders aside.
Machamp flexed.
Prof. Kukui
Dulse's trial is up in the Wilds. Go on, I'll be around.

Where to?

Stay here
